newsitem.title: LATVIA: LITHUANIA, LATVIA COMMISSIONS READY AGREEMENT.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA, LATVIA COMMISSIONS READY AGREEMENT.

text.p: Stock market and central depository officials from Latvia and Lithuania will meet this week to prepare a cooperation deal, the Latvian bourse said on Tuesday.

The bourse said in a statement that Lithuanian markets commission chairman Virgilius Poderys, the vice-president of the Lithuanian stock exchange and the president of the stock exchange would arrive in Riga.
"The purpose of this visit is to prepare a cooperation protocol between the securities market commissions of Latvia and Lithuania," the bourse added.
A press conference will be held on July 16 to explain the details of the agreement.
